The connecting map and dim count are for the underlying O_C-extension (k-vector spaces); Serre duality over the residue field forces dim_k H^1(C_{k[eps]},L)=1, hence the only k[eps]-module of k-dimension 1 is k[eps]/(eps) with Fit_0=(eps). theorem_statement: Let B be a locally Noetherian scheme (no reducedness, irreducibility or characteristic hypothesis), pi : C -> B smooth proper with geometrically connected fibres of genus g >= 1, and x_1,...,x_n : B -> C pairwise disjoint sections with n >= 1, Gamma := sum_i x_i(B). Let W be locally free of rank 2 on C equipped with a short exact sequence of O_C-modules 0 -> W_4 -> W -> W_5 -> 0 with W_4, W_5 invertible of fibrewise degrees d_4, d_5 satisfying (D1) d_4 - n > 2g - 2 and (D2) d_5 - n = 2g - 2. Let phi : pi_*W -> pi_*(W|_Gamma) be evaluation, Z_ev := V(Fit_0(coker phi)) the Casnati-Ekedahl evaluation-failure locus with its determinantal/Fitting scheme structure, N := omega_{C/B} tensor W_5^vee(Gamma) (invertible of fibrewise degree 0 by (D2)), a_N : B -> Pic^0_{C/B} its classifying morphism and e the identity section. Then: (T1) pi_*W and pi_*(W|_Gamma) are locally free of ranks d_4 + d_5 + 2 - 2g and 2n, so Fit_0(coker phi) = I_{2n}(phi); (T2) on P := Pic^0_{C/B}, with L_univ := omega_{C_P/P}(Gamma_P) tensor Poin^{-1} and Phi : p_*L_univ -> p_*(L_univ|_{Gamma_P}) the universal evaluation, one has the exact equality of ideal sheaves J := Fit_0(coker Phi) = I_e, both inclusions, over every such B; (T3) Fit_0(coker phi) = Fit_0(coker phi_5) with phi_5 : pi_*W_5 -> pi_*(W_5|_Gamma), using only the filtration and never a splitting W = W_4 direct-sum W_5; (T4) Fit_0(coker phi) = a_N^{-1}(I_e).O_B, i.e. Z_ev = a_N^{-1}(e(B)) as closed subschemes of B; (T5) formation of both sides commutes with arbitrary base change, and for every locally Noetherian B-scheme T the map T -> B factors through Z_ev if and only if N|_{C_T} is relatively trivial (isomorphic to pi_T^*M for some invertible M on T), whence the identification descends verbatim to any locally Noetherian algebraic stack carrying this data, via any smooth atlas; and (T6) for (g,n) = (6,6) the balanced tetragonal Casnati-Ekedahl datum satisfies the hypotheses: with gamma : C -> P^1_B finite flat of degree 4, relations bundle F fibrewise O(4) direct-sum O(5), the canonical sub-line-bundle L_5 := O_{P^1}(5) tensor q^*q_*(F(-5)) subset F and its quotient L_4 induce a canonical filtration 0 -> W_4 -> W -> W_5 -> 0 of W := (O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^*F^vee)|_C with d_4 = 20 and d_5 = 16 (SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 convention W_f = (O(2) tensor gamma^*O(-f))|_C), so that (D1) reads 14 > 10 and (D2) reads 10 = 2g-2, phi has ranks 26 -> 12, and Z_ev = a_N^{-1}(e(B)) with N = omega_{C/B} tensor W_5^vee(Gamma), equivalently Z_ev is the scheme-theoretic locus where O_C(Gamma) is isomorphic to W_5 tensor omega_{C/B}^{-1} relatively to B.
